''See also: [[black dragon's breath Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Black dragons{{!}}Black dragon's breath is a destructive [[technique]] associated with the [[Path of Black Flame]]. It typically manifests as bars, streams, or spears of liquid-looking black and [[Red madra|red madra]] that can be launched from the hands or mouth. The [[technique]] is characterized by its intense heat and destructive properties, capable of drilling through targets, slicing through [[stone]], or obliterating physical objects. When used by practitioners like [[Lindon]], it can be condensed into thin beams or expanded into massive waves of flame. The power of the breath is often linked to the user's [[soulfire]] and spiritual [[Authority|authority]], and it can be used as a [[Striker technique]] to pierce defenses or as a tool for [[destruction]]. In some instances, the breath is described as having a primal, savage quality that mirrors the power of actual [[Black dragons|black dragons]].}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Black dragons{{!}}black dragon's breath is a [[technique]] utilized by [[Lindon]] that functions by tearing through the air. During his training, [[Lindon]] struggled with the ability to form the [[technique]] in a timely manner. He eventually learned to gather the [[dragon]]'s breath into his left hand for use. This [[technique]] can reach a significant size, as seen when [[Orthos]]'s [[dragon]]'s breath became arm-thick.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|[[Lindon]] demonstrates his mastery of this [[technique]] by hurling [[dragon]]'s breath upward into the sky. During his confrontation with [[Akura Pride|Pride]], he secures a victory by peppering his opponent with the [[technique]]. The power of Black dragons{{!}}black dragon's breath is further showcased when it is released from the surrounding trees. This energy can be shaped into bars, and a concentrated spear of the breath is capable of breaking through a cloud.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The potential for Black dragons{{!}}black dragon's breath first manifested through a twitch in Lindon's Remnant arm{{!}}Lindon's right arm. During a confrontation with the [[Monarchs]], [[Lindon]] utilized three streams of this power to crush a [[Script|script]] and annihilate a [[Herald]]-level shield. [[Orthos]] also demonstrated the [[technique]] by unleashing flows of [[dragon]]'s breath, which were used to blast a [[construct]] apart. While the Weeping [[Dragon's breath]] is recognized as a deadly offensive method, [[Lindon]] encountered a claw infused with Black dragons{{!}}black dragon's breath, and [[Orthos]] employed the power himself. Even [[Malice]] was able to wade through the Black dragons{{!}}black dragon's breath by utilizing her armor.}}
